text:
toni: Quick help — BrickWorks POC getting 401 Invalid API key when calling embeddings. We gave them sk-brick-demo-2026. They're sending X-Redwood-Project: brickworks-poc.

jamal: 401. First guess: key not present in region they're hitting or disabled. Ask for curl + response and which host they resolve to.

irene: They pasted this (redacted):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \\
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk-brick-demo-2026\" \\
  -H \"X-Redwood-Project: brickworks-poc\" \\
  -d '{\"input\":\"ping\"}'
```
Response: {\"error\":\"Invalid API key\",\"code\":401}

toni: They also said their infra team rewrites requests through an edge proxy that pins traffic to our us-east-1 region.

infra-bot: log: [2026-01-08T09:12:03Z] key=sk-brick-demo-2026 action=auth-check result=not-found region=eu-west-1

jamal: infra-bot shows key exists in eu-west-1 but proxy goes to us-east-1 -> mismatch. Two options: rotate the connectivity or create a demo key in us-east-1.

irene: Also note they briefly saw 403 when project header was missing. That matches project-binding enforcement.

toni: I created a temp presales key bound to brickworks-poc in us-east-1 and sent via secure DM. Command used (admin only):
```bash
redwoodctl keys create --org brickworks --project brickworks-poc --region us-east-1 --scopes embeddings --label \"brick presales temp\"
```

infra-bot: log: [2026-01-08T09:15:30Z] key=sk-brick-temp-77 action=create region=us-east-1 owner=toni bound_projects=[\"brickworks-poc\"]
toni: Customer retried, now 200 and embeddings returned. :white_check_mark:

jamal: Follow-ups: 1) revoke old demo key sk-brick-demo-2026 (rotation) 2) add region-agnostic example to sample repo or clearly call out region flag 3) respond to security questionnaire: programmatic revoke + rotation snippet + KMS note.

irene: For the security doc: we provide programmatic key revoke in control plane (DELETE /v1/keys/{key_id}) authenticated with admin/service token; production customers get UI + API and can integrate with KMS for CMKs. I'll draft a one-paragraph answer.

toni: Also capture throughput ask — they expect ~120k embeddings/day. Jamal please advise on volume pricing or Dedicated options.

jamal: Will do. Closing this thread, customer back in testing.
